name: ATHENA-stub
author: MeagerPotato
description: ATHENA-stub: the inference contract of FishAI's ATHENA line, not a player. A fixed-weight GRU network of the candidate family (size S, random init from a fixed seed) chooses among the legal moves; the rules-certain declare is a hard rail; MUSTFIX and PASSFIX are in the adapter. The weight file's md5 is pinned below.
